tagline: Next.js at the core. Mobile-ready at the edges.

landing.title: A template for web and mobile projects without collapsing both architectures together.
landing.description: This base follows the repository guide: Next.js owns the application structure, Capacitor wraps native behavior, and reusable Expo logic enters as shared domain code.

start.title: A foundation ready to grow across web, Android, and iOS.
start.description: The structure uses src/app, public routes and a protected portal, Base-Next-inspired i18n, and isolated mobile adapters for biometrics, camera, files, and notifications.
start.transitionDescription: This screen exists only to test the entry flow and redirects automatically to the public home page.

pillars.title: Base-Next structure
pillars.body: The web base is the main reference. The App Router defines public pages, layout, and the protected portal.

pillars.title: Base-Next style i18n
pillars.body: Translations live under public/locales and the client layer uses i18next with detector and HTTP backend, matching the web reference.

pillars.title: Expo protection adapted
pillars.body: The portal changes behavior by platform: web validates session; mobile can require biometrics before unlocking the protected area.

login.title: Sign in to the protected area
login.subtitle: Initial flow with Zod validation, cookies for web, and optional biometric preference on mobile.
login.helper: Use any valid email and a password with at least 6 characters.
login.error: We could not complete the sign-in flow.
login.biometricOptIn: Enable biometrics on mobile when available

portal.title: Protected portal with platform-specific flow.
portal.subtitle: On web, the session follows a cookie-based approach. On mobile, biometrics can be required before unlocking the portal.
sections: Session persisted in storage and cookies to mirror the Base-Next web behavior.
Per-user biometric preference inspired by the Base-Expo protection flow.
Portal isolated under /portal to keep public and protected routes clearly separated.
portal.mobileMessage: Mobile biometric flow: identity can be validated before protected content is shown.
portal.webMessage: Web flow: protected navigation depends on the current session, without a biometric prompt.
portal.biometricDescription: Confirm your identity to continue using the portal on this device.
portal.checkingDescription: Please wait for confirmation on the device.

home.title: Public home for the unified base.
home.subtitle: This route now works as a showcase for components, mocks, and layout patterns for the web-first product.
home.mobileSubtitle: On mobile without a session, the public home is reduced to the main entry flows and quick settings.
home.publicDescription: The public home is intentionally minimal. The examples and test components now appear only inside the private home.
home.quickConfigSubtitle: Language, theme and font available before sign-in.
home.tableSubtitle: One data source: table on web and cards on phones.
home.tableCaption: Mock requests to validate the new GenericTable.
home.formSubtitle: Compact form area for testing adaptive buttons and mobile ergonomics.
sections: Start and Home remain public inside the application.
Portal contains only the authenticated and protected experience.
The mobile flow can add biometrics only when the user enters the private area.

developer.title: Developer mode
developer.description: Tools imported from the Expo flow and adapted to the current web/mobile shell.
developer.quickAccessDescription: Shows quick sign-in buttons and test shortcuts on authentication screens.
developer.formBlocksDescription: Keeps the behavior that blocks steps when the flow has validation issues.
developer.zodValidationDescription: Turns schema validation on or off for the sample form flow.
developer.mockedDataDescription: Marks the interface as powered by local sample data for layout and navigation tests.
developer.ignoreTlsDescription: Keeps insecure-environment behavior reserved for local and staging scenarios.
developer.webShell: Web shell active: classic header, wide content and footer.
developer.mobileShell: Mobile shell active: contextual top bar, compact content and an easy-reach bottom bar.

system.title: Layout structure panel
system.description: Global physical-grid configuration panel for validating the SystemContext in real time.
system.disabledFallback: System panel disabled. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SYSTEM_PANEL_ENABLED=true in .env to enable it.
system.liveNotice: Changes made here are local and in-memory. The default fallback stays disabled when the public flag is missing or false.
system.headerVisibleDescription: Keeps the top structural region mounted in the grid.
system.leftSidebarVisibleDescription: Keeps the left structural region mounted in the grid.
system.rightSidebarVisibleDescription: Keeps the right structural region mounted in the grid.
system.footerVisibleDescription: Keeps the bottom structural region mounted in the grid.
system.headerHeightDescription: Structural height in pixels for the top region.
system.footerHeightDescription: Structural height in pixels for the bottom region.
system.leftSidebarWidthDescription: Structural width in pixels for the left region.
system.rightSidebarWidthDescription: Structural width in pixels for the right region.
system.mainContentCardMarginDescription: Structural margin in pixels applied to the MainContent card when Card mode is active.
system.zIndexHeaderDescription: Structural stacking order for the top region.
system.zIndexFooterDescription: Structural stacking order for the bottom region.
system.mainContentModeDescription: Structural base mode for the main content region.

profile.title: Profile and preferences
profile.subtitle: Single area for account data and application settings on web and mobile.
profile.accountSubtitle: Structure inspired by the Expo profile page, adapted to the project's web-first flow.
profile.configSubtitle: Language, font and theme stay together here on mobile and inside the web profile page.
profile.schemeLightHint: You configure the light theme; dark is derived automatically.
profile.schemeBuiltinHint: Built-in scheme. Add a new one to customize colors.

register.title: Public registration
register.subtitle: Simple registration page to validate public navigation in the current test flow.
register.description: The real registration flow can live here later. For now, this screen exists to support the reduced mobile home with two main buttons.

persons.title: People
persons.subtitle: Adaptive list: full table on desktop and cards on the phone, mirroring the Expo base people module.
persons.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this person?
persons.demoAction: demo feature (no backend in this base)

analytics.title: Charts demo
analytics.subtitle: The most-used chart types in the shadcn style (Recharts), with theme tokens and desktop/mobile adaptation.
analytics.areaSubtitle: Visits per month, desktop and mobile stacked.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address you tried to reach does not exist or was moved.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again shortly.

unauthorized.title: Access not authorized
unauthorized.description: You don't have permission to access this area.

documentation.title: Base documentation
documentation.subtitle: Full project guide: the README and every document in the docs folder, rendered here.
